note: Zero-shot skill transfer pilot (transfer_eval_v1): a frozen winning skill from a train task is evaluated zero-shot (--max-iterations 0, no adaptation) on a different test task. Each of the 8 rows is one train→test fold, not a SkillsBench task; 'task' names the fold. cap-evolve's own per-fold test_delta is always 0.0 by construction under --max-iterations 0 (the frozen donor skill is the only artifact evaluated, so it's compared against itself) and is NOT reproduced here. Instead reward_baseline/reward_opt show the real comparison the source report makes: the test task's own native seed score (pre-optimization, from the task-by-task-87 run) vs. the transferred donor skill's score on that same task. Net effect across all 8 folds is negative (0.2125 → 0.1625): transfer gives a small lift only where the native seed was already near zero, and actively hurts (-0.5, -0.6) on the one task (weighted-gdp-calc) with a strong native seed. Sample size is 8 folds over 5 tasks in 2 domains — directional only, not conclusive. Full per-fold detail, methodology, and operational notes: results/transfer-eval-8fold/summary.md on the skillsbench-history branch.
